criteria.requirement: Add explicit wrapt.async_cache.async_lru_cache(maxsize=128) for coroutine functions, storing only successful completed values in per-running-loop bounded LRU. Repeat await same call works, exceptions and cancellation never cache; clear during in-flight compute advances generation so its later success returns only to caller without repopulating cleared cache. Expose current-loop cache_info/cache_clear, preserve metadata and descriptor binding through normal async function. Concurrent same-key misses explicitly may compute separately, no singleflight. Keys are hashable args+sorted kwargs including method self, normal result/argument retention until eviction/clear. Default synchronous lru_cache unchanged.
